attributes.Interface: Flexible client/line, ETH/OTN configuration / 12 x SFP+ ports  / 10GE / OTU2e, selectable per port / B&W, Bidir, CWDM, DWDM, fixed or tunable transceivers
attributes.Backplane interface: Backplane N+1 ILKN mating with uplinks 20P200, S13X100R, S13X100E, S13X400H, S13X400E
attributes.Packet networking: IEEE 802.1Q Provider Bridging with S-VLAN and/or C-VLANs manipulation for connectionless packet transport / MPLS-TP for connection-oriented packet transport + VPLS-TP
attributes.MEF services: All Carrier Ethernet service types: E-Line, E-LAN, E-Tree, Access E-Line, Transit E-Line / Private (port-based) and virtual (VLAN-based) services
attributes.QoS: Multi-CoS architecture aligned with MEF, using SR OS service model with deep packet buffering / Flexible ingress classification, rate control/policing, queuing, congestion management, and scheduling options

attributes.Interface: Flexible client/line configuration / 12 x SFP / SFP+ ports  / FE / 1GE / 10GE selectable per port / B&W, Bidir, CWDM, DWDM, fixed or tunable transceivers  / TSoP, CSoP, TPoP Smart SFPs
